title: The faction's Builder flies home to Node Beta Industrial Station from one of our outposts after a build there (Logistics)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-25 06:54 UTC (orders ENT-092 P3; rule F8). The Builder founded CLTV Outpost Atria and stood docked there with every route of its list closed (why_closed.py: builder-home-node-beta done once; haul-network-builder only in node_beta and nexus_prime). This route takes it home from an outpost of ours whenever it stands in one (requires.in_system the outposts' systems, requires.role builder), standing work judged by the builds it serves, never by its own pay. Not once: every build at an outpost ends there.
